NUMERICAL SCOPE / 18 OCTOBER 2026

Make the model fit the method.

Periodic

1D/2D rectangular periodic domains. Fourier derivatives and ETDRK4; supported constant diagonal linear operators with an explicit remainder.

Second-order bounded

1D/2D rectangles. Constant nonnegative diagonal diffusion; Dirichlet, Neumann and passive Robin data. Robin coefficients are nonnegative constants or parameters, not both zero.

Fourth-order bounded

1D intervals. Negative constant leading fourth-order term per field and two admissible linear boundary rows at each end. No 2D nonperiodic fourth-order backend.

Shared limits

One to three fields. CPU Float64 arithmetic. Explicit nonlinear terms still require time-step checks. Centered transport is not a shock-capturing scheme. The interface rejects unsupported expressions, but cannot certify continuum well-posedness of every accepted model.

Interpretation

Three-level comparisons estimate observed behavior. Balance closure and boundary residuals test discrete consistency. Finite-time parameter scans do not trace solution branches. Imported data and supplied reference formulas remain subject to verification.
